steps.title: Shape detectives

options.label: Choose the flat shape with three straight sides.
Which whole object is a solid cube?
This shape has turned. What is its name now?

steps.hint: Trace the sides with your finger and count them.
steps.explanation: Use sides, corners and flat or solid parts to recognise shapes.
steps.shortExplanation: Make, count or compare the objects. Explain what changed.

mathWorkshop.title: Shape detectives
mathWorkshop.goal: Use sides, corners and flat or solid parts to recognise shapes.

tasks.prompt: Choose the flat shape with three straight sides.
tasks.feedback: A triangle has three straight sides and three corners.
tasks.hint: Trace the sides with your finger and count them.

tasks.prompt: Which whole object is a solid cube?
tasks.feedback: The cube is solid. A square is the flat shape on each of its faces.
tasks.hint: Look for a shape with depth, rather than only a flat drawing.

tasks.prompt: This shape has turned. What is its name now?
tasks.feedback: It is still a square. Turning leaves its four equal sides and four corners unchanged.
tasks.hint: Count the sides and corners. Turning does not stretch the shape.

parentReview.en: Guided practice is ungraded. Completion records the child doing the activities, not a book-question score.

steps.title: Maths discovery 2
steps.prompt: Match each flat shape to its name.
steps.hint: Count sides and corners; look for flat or curved faces.
steps.explanation: Count straight sides and corners to name the shapes.
steps.shortExplanation: Count straight sides and corners to name the shapes.

steps.title: Maths discovery 3
steps.prompt: I have 4 corners and 4 equal sides. What am I?
steps.hint: Count sides and corners; look for flat or curved faces.
steps.explanation: A square has 4 equal sides and 4 corners.
steps.shortExplanation: A square has 4 equal sides and 4 corners.

steps.title: Maths discovery 4
steps.prompt: I have 6 square faces and 8 corners. What am I?
steps.hint: Count sides and corners; look for flat or curved faces.
steps.explanation: A cube has 6 square faces and 8 corners.
steps.shortExplanation: A cube has 6 square faces and 8 corners.

steps.title: Maths discovery 5
steps.hint: Count sides and corners; look for flat or curved faces.
steps.explanation: A triangle has 3 sides and 3 corners.
steps.shortExplanation: A triangle has 3 sides and 3 corners.

steps.title: Maths discovery 6
steps.prompt: Choose all the shapes that can roll.
steps.hint: Count sides and corners; look for flat or curved faces.
steps.explanation: Spheres and cylinders have curved parts that let them roll.
steps.shortExplanation: Spheres and cylinders have curved parts that let them roll.

steps.title: Maths discovery 7
steps.prompt: Sort flat drawings and solid objects.
steps.hint: Count sides and corners; look for flat or curved faces.
steps.explanation: Flat drawings are 2D. Objects you can hold are 3D.
steps.shortExplanation: Flat drawings are 2D. Objects you can hold are 3D.

source.answerKeyText: 2D: square, triangle, circle • 3D: ball, tin, dice

steps.title: Maths discovery 8
steps.prompt: A square turned onto its corner is still a square.
steps.hint: Count sides and corners; look for flat or curved faces.
steps.explanation: Turning does not change its 4 equal sides or 4 corners.
steps.shortExplanation: Turning does not change its 4 equal sides or 4 corners.

source.answerKeyText: True. It still has 4 equal sides and 4 corners.

steps.title: Try it at home
steps.prompt: With an adult, draw a house using squares, rectangles and triangles. Count your triangles.
steps.hint: Count sides and corners; look for flat or curved faces.
steps.explanation: Try it with an adult. Talk about what you found.
steps.shortExplanation: Try it with an adult. Talk about what you found.

source.answerKeyText: Any house built from the named shapes; the number of triangles must match his drawing.

parentReview.en: Any house built from the named shapes; the number of triangles must match his drawing.
parentReview.note: Discuss with an adult; this personal or drawing response is not automatically graded.

steps.title: Maths discovery 10
steps.hint: Count sides and corners; look for flat or curved faces.
steps.explanation: Sphere is the answer. A football is a solid round shape.
steps.shortExplanation: Sphere is the answer. A football is a solid round shape.

steps.title: Maths discovery 11
steps.hint: Count sides and corners; look for flat or curved faces.
steps.explanation: Cuboid is the answer. A cereal box has rectangular faces.
steps.shortExplanation: Cuboid is the answer. A cereal box has rectangular faces.

steps.title: Maths discovery 12
steps.hint: Count sides and corners; look for flat or curved faces.
steps.explanation: 4 corners is the answer. A rectangle has four corners.
steps.shortExplanation: 4 corners is the answer. A rectangle has four corners.

steps.title: Maths discovery 13
steps.hint: Count sides and corners; look for flat or curved faces.
steps.explanation: Circle is the answer. A circle is round with no corners.
steps.shortExplanation: Circle is the answer. A circle is round with no corners.

steps.title: Maths discovery 14
steps.prompt: A tin pushed into sand leaves the print of a...
steps.hint: Count sides and corners; look for flat or curved faces.
steps.explanation: Circle is the answer. A cylinder has a circular flat face.
steps.shortExplanation: Circle is the answer. A cylinder has a circular flat face.

stickers.meaning: An edge of a flat shape.

homeActivities.text: Find safe objects shaped like a cube, cuboid, sphere, cylinder or cone. Predict which roll or stack, then test and trace flat faces.
homeActivities.textAr: دوّروا في البيت على حاجات آمنة شكلها مكعب أو متوازي مستطيلات أو كورة أو أسطوانة أو مخروط. توقعوا أنهي هتتدحرج وأنهي تترص فوق بعض، وبعدين جرّبوا، وارسموا حوالين الوشوش المسطحة.
homeActivities.safety: An adult supervises. Keep small objects away from younger children. An adult handles scissors. Use water at the sink, away from electrical items.
homeActivities.safetyAr: لازم شخص كبير يكون موجود. خلّي الحاجات الصغيرة بعيد عن الأطفال الأصغر، والكبير يمسك المقص. أنشطة المية تكون عند الحوض وبعيد عن الكهرباء.
